create-plugin.reason: Only --skip-install controls this handler. Clone and setup flags do not apply.

governance.reason: Governance reports current status. Agent setup, team log limits, and broker installation options do not apply.

guard.reason: Guard actions have no command-specific options. Install parser options belong to observed programs.

guard-observe.reason: Only global Kit options precede the tool. All subsequent arguments belong to the observed tool.

ingest.reason: Ingest can format parsed findings as JSON. It does not create an attestation.

open.reason: Open accepts a service name. It has no structured output option.

run.reason: Run uses global Kit options. Arguments after the separator belong to the child command.

whoami.reason: Whoami supports JSON output. Status mode selection does not apply.
